title: Show the remaining time instead of the progressbar on click if show progressbar only
line: With only the progress bar shown in the panel, clicking the Timer now opens a popup with the remaining time instead of just a thin bar.
explanation: The popup's time display used the "Show remaining time" setting, which is meant for what the panel itself shows. With only the progress bar enabled, the popup hid the time too and was an empty area around a thin progress bar, with no way to read or set the time. The change always shows the time in the panel popup; the desktop widget still follows the setting.

commits.message:
applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" only decides what the panel itself shows, but the
popup followed it too, so with it off the popup was an empty area around
a thin progress bar. The popup now always shows the time above the bar.

BUG: 521348
BUG: 488937

patches.diff:
From 42b6ce14a91e0cdc8186c2d4ec668b23a43198f1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 22:20:24 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" only decides what the panel itself shows, but the
popup followed it too, so with it off the popup was an empty area around
a thin progress bar. The popup now always shows the time above the bar.

BUG: 521348
BUG: 488937
---
 applets/timer/TimerView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
index dc1f94e40..d50b72461 100644
--- a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
+++ b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@ MouseArea {
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.fillHeight: true
             Layout.verticalStretchFactor: 3
-            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime || fullRepresentation.inPanel
 
             value: fullRepresentation.seconds
             editable: !fullRepresentation.running
--

media.caption: Progress bar only: the popup is just a thin bar
Same setup: the popup shows the remaining time above the bar

review.text: One-line fix at the real cause: the popup's time display reused the panel-only "Show remaining time" setting; it now always shows in the panel popup while the desktop widget keeps following the setting. Same change as MR !1235, still applies on master after the Kirigami.Forms rework. Media shows the empty popup and the fixed one.
